analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied units are base text at lines 1629-2248, covering the native MiMo, Flint, Coordinator-serving and Bonsai sections. The changed ranges are base 404-407 and head 404-410 and 1050-1070, which are outside the supplied base text, so the supplied units do not show the changed lines. The patch excerpt is truncated: it describes eviction releasing reclaimable memory before load and parked free 64 MiB KV segments reused across admissions, and its last sentence is cut off. I cannot verify the full head text. This is documentation only, with no code, deployment or configuration change visible, so no security control is changed by the PR itself. Documented behavior touches TB-007 (inference engine memory) and T-028 (residual GPU/KV data). Parked free KV segments are reinstalled by the next admission of the same size class, outside the grant and ledger charge. If the implementation does not zero or overwrite them, prior request KV data could be exposed to later requests (T-028), and the parked memory is uncharged (T-029/DoS). The supplied evidence does not establish this: the patch is truncated and no code is shown. Next pass: check the source change that this doc describes, the parking and reinstall path in the paged KV pool, and whether reuse is scoped per request and cleared. Also check whether the zero-fill-on-demand host-page wrapping applies to reused segments. Also check whether T-028 and the memory-accounting text need updating. The existing T-041 prefix-cache text and the rest of the base text are unchanged by this patch. Nothing in the visible units contradicts the threat model.
